summary: Lets you click any candle to start an Anchored VWAP from that bar, with standard-deviation bands, in one step from the picker.
overview: This picker row is a shortcut for Anchored VWAP. After you choose it, the chart asks you to click a bar. The bar you click becomes the anchor, and an Anchored VWAP with its standard-deviation bands is added from that point.
how: The row watches for your next click or tap on the chart and reads the time of the bar under the pointer. It then adds the Anchored VWAP indicator with that time as its anchor. Press Escape to cancel. If no bar was under the pointer, a message asks you to try again.
The line itself is the Anchored VWAP: typical price weighted by volume from the anchor onward, with bands at 1, 2 and 3 standard deviations.
use: Some traders anchor to a swing high or low to see the average price since that turn.
Use it to anchor to a news bar or the session open.
Some traders add several anchors to compare averages from different points.
notes: Each click adds a new Anchored VWAP; you can change its settings afterwards.
See Anchored VWAP for the full description of the line and bands.
